navDescriptor: WCAG checks on every page, in plain words.

seo.title: Accessibility checks on every page, to WCAG A, AA or AAA | Superflow
seo.description: Agents check contrast, alt text, headings, labels, focus and captions on every page and every change. Findings read in plain words. You pick the WCAG level per site.

hero.h1: Every page checked to WCAG, in plain words.
hero.sub: Agents check contrast, alt text, headings, labels, focus and captions on every change. Your team decides which level to hold and what to fix first.
hero.clientLine: Your client sees the findings in plain words and taps Approve on the fixes.

pack.name: Accessibility Agent Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for WCAG. Every page, desktop and phone, on every change.

agents.name: Contrast
agents.checks: Checks text contrast meets the level you set.
agents.finding: Body text is 3.1:1 against the background. AA needs 4.5:1.

agents.name: Alt Text
agents.checks: Finds images with no alt text or the file name as alt.
agents.finding: 41 images have no alt text. 12 use the file name.

agents.name: Heading Order
agents.checks: Checks each page has one H1 and headings nest in order.
agents.finding: /about has three H1s and skips from H2 to H4.

agents.name: Form Labels
agents.checks: Checks every input has a label a screen reader can read.
agents.finding: Newsletter email field has no label.

agents.name: Focus Order
agents.checks: Checks keyboard focus is visible and reaches every control in order.
agents.finding: Focus skips the main menu. Keyboard users cannot open it.

agents.name: Link Text
agents.checks: Finds 'click here', 'learn more' and empty links.
agents.finding: 19 links read 'Learn more'. Screen readers hear nothing else.

agents.name: Media Captions
agents.checks: Checks video has captions and audio has a transcript.

agents.name: Tap Targets
agents.checks: Checks tap targets on phone are big enough.
agents.finding: 14 footer links are 28px tall. The minimum is 44px.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any PDF linked from the site that has no text layer.
buildYourOwn.finding: 7 linked PDFs are scans with no text layer.

faq.a: No. Agents check what a machine can check and report it in plain words. A human audit covers the rest.
You pick A, AA or AAA per site. Most clients ask for AA.

faq.q: Does it cover the European Accessibility Act?
faq.a: Agents check the WCAG criteria the Act relies on. The legal call stays with you and your client.
